description: Replaces the complement lookup ('complement in seen') with a current-number lookup ('num in seen'), causing the function to check for duplicates instead of complements. This produces wrong answers on most inputs and teaches the importance of understanding what value to look up in the hash table.

logic.description: Replace 'complement' with 'num' in the membership test, so the code checks if the current number (not the complement) has been seen before

metadata.author: Generated (CP Accelerator), rewritten to use supported replacement types
metadata.note: Original bug used unsupported 'move_after' type. Redesigned to use 'replace_value_with' to change the lookup variable from complement to num. This tests whether the student understands that the hash table lookup must search for (target - current) not just current.
